tier1.text: The calcaneus, or heel bone, carries body weight to the ground. It is the largest of the seven tarsal bones, which form the rear of the foot. The calcaneal tendon, or Achilles tendon, joins muscles at the back of the leg to this bone.

sentences.text: The calcaneus, or heel bone, carries body weight to the ground.

quotes.quote: Body weight from the talus is transmitted to the ground by both ends of the medial and lateral longitudinal foot arches. Weight is passed posteriorly through both arches to the calcaneus bone, which forms the heel of the foot and is in contact with the ground.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: calcaneus: heel bone; posterior, inferior tarsal bone that forms the heel of the foot
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: It is the largest of the seven tarsal bones, which form the rear of the foot.

quotes.quote: The irregular and largest tarsal bone that forms the heel.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: tarsal bone: one of the seven bones that make up the posterior foot; includes the calcaneus, talus, navicular, cuboid, medial cuneiform, intermediate cuneiform, and lateral cuneiform bones
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The calcaneal tendon, or Achilles tendon, joins muscles at the back of the leg to this bone.

quotes.quote: The superficial muscles in the posterior compartment of the leg all insert onto the calcaneal tendon (Achilles tendon), a strong tendon that inserts into the calcaneal bone of the ankle.
quotes.section: 11.6 Appendicular Muscles of the Pelvic Girdle and Lower Limbs
